messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — NimbleFin cohort showing a drop in daily active seats after week 2. Need to align on enrollment fixes and proactive renewal outreach. Can we triage enrollment signals + plan a targeted enablement touch?
Alex Chen: I pulled their seat roster and enablement attendance. They attended 3 sessions but only 18% completed the sample workflow. Quick query I ran: ```SELECT user_id, last_active_at FROM beta_usage WHERE customer='nimblefin' AND last_active_at < now() - interval '14 days';``` I'll paste the CSV to the shared drive.
Maya Patel: Top signals so far: low task completion (stuck on step 3) and a retrieval quality regression — likely embedding mismatch for some legacy docs.
Samir Rao: I'll investigate the embeddings mapping today. If it's a tokenizer/normalization gap it's a quick preprocess patch. ETA: push PR to staging by EOD.
Becca L.: Heads up — Jordan (AE) noted NimbleFin is "on the fence" for renewal; they called out latency in the test pipeline and inconsistent examples from the prompt templates. We should lock a mitigation plan before QBR.
CS Bot: renewal-risk updated for customer=nimblefin: score=0.62 tags=[low-engagement, latency] (auto-update)
Maya Patel: Proposed plan:
- Quick fix: Samir to deliver mapping patch and short runbook.
- Enablement: Alex + Becca to run a targeted hands-on session for power users (walk through sample workflow + sandbox).
- Escalation: Jordan to prep renewal playbook + exec intro if risk > 0.7.
Alex Chen: :thumbsup: I can create a tailored sandbox and notebook tomorrow 10–11am PT, and provide API keys scoped to test data. I'll also produce a short checklist for the session.
Samir Rao: Working on mapping now. Will add `scripts/fix-embed-mapping.sh` and a quick verification script `tools/verify-embedding-coverage.py`. Will post staging link when ready.
Becca L.: I'll loop Jordan in and schedule a 15-min debrief with the NimbleFin CSMs. Plan to send a 3-question survey post-session to capture immediate signal (ease, value, blockers).
Jordan Mills: Thanks — will prepare renewal talking points focused on latency SLOs, dedicated test window, and an options matrix (discount vs. committed capacity). If the mapping patch improves retrieval, I can push a tentative renewal discussion into next week.
Maya Patel: Nice — can everyone drop a one-line update in this thread once your action is done? I'll consolidate a short summary for the renewal owner and update the pulse.
Alex Chen: Will post sandbox link once keys are created.
Samir Rao: PR in staging in ~2h, will report back here after verification.
Becca L.: Meeting invite sent for the enablement slot. Survey draft uploaded to the drive.
CS Bot: engagement-metric delta: week2->week3 active_users = -22% (auto-note)
Maya Patel: Thanks team — priority is to stabilize retrieval + run the targeted enablement. If we still see >10% drop after that, Jordan to escalate to exec call.
